page.layout: One page of text, all centred: the title block at top, a smaller italic summary block in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. A handwritten ownership inscription runs along the bottom edge and is not printed text, so it is left out.

main_text.l: IJ. PARALIP. VI. CAP. A' LV-

l.i: In prima Concione docetur , unde fit annonæ
caritas & fames,nimirum à Deo, & quàm dira
& grauis pœna sit demonstratur. Altera, qua
de causa Deus hoc flagello bonos pariter ac ma-
los, castigare soleat. Tertia demum, quomodo
publicè, privatimque tempore famis singuli sese
divinæ, quibus electis suis auxilium pollicetur,

page.notes: Handwritten ownership inscription at the bottom (Latin dedication to "D. Leonardo Ferrario"-type name, with "Altorfiano" and "compatri") is not printed and is omitted; the reading of it is uncertain. "Recenseniur" appears as printed but is doubtful (possibly a misprint for "Recensentur"). The "A'" after "CAP." and the "IJ." in the Scripture reference are copied as they appear on the scan. The "A" in "DE CARITA-" is followed by a printer's dash, read as a line-end hyphen. In the summary block, "vnde" and "diuinæ" and "priuatimque" were changed to u/v spelling per the convention.
